s=s[:start]+'''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The two descending diagonal sides form an outlined wedge; fill its interior.
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c] == 0:
                # Count same-color outline cells on the two diagonals up-left/up-right.
                for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row if v):
                    for d in range(1, min(r+1, w-c, c+1)):
                        if grid[r-d][c-d] == color and grid[r-d][c+d] == color:
                            out[r][c] = 2
                            break
                    if out[r][c] != 0:
                        break
    return out
''' +s[end:]
open(p,'w').write(s)
